    Proposition 12.5 for the algebra A₀ of a representation-finite algebra #

    deformation-refinements.tex (prop:full-hochschild-comparison). For the mesh category C = k(Γ_A) of a basic representation-finite algebra A, the mesh presentations are resolutions (they come from the almost split sequences; the paragraph after Lemma 12.3), so Ψ : HH²(A₀)_q → coker D_{q+1} is an isomorphism in every internal degree q ≥ 1 (MeshWalk.fullHochschildComparison).
